title: Quera tester_config
description: Judge configuration for a Quera project judge. Test scores across all packages must sum to 100.

packages.description: Scoring groups. Every listed test belongs to exactly one package.

name.description: Descriptive English name for this package, shown in the judge report.

score.description: Points awarded for this package. Scores across all packages must total exactly 100.

tests.description: Test identifiers, matching the test function or file names in the judge.

aggregator.description: How the package's per-test results combine into its score.

number_of_tests.description: Total test count. Must be at least the number of tests listed across all packages.
